text: dsh-task-completion-beep 是一款面向 DSH Web 的轻量提示音插件：当网页任务运行结束时，在浏览器播放五声短音。它把客户端模块注入 DSH Web，并观察界面中的运行状态变化，也响应宿主发出的任务完成事件。提示音由 Web Audio API 实时生成，无需音频文件或额外服务。适合希望在切换窗口或暂时离开页面时，通过声音留意任务结束的 DSH Web 用户。

dsh-task-completion-beep plays five short tones in DSH Web when a task finishes. Its browser client watches for the interface to change from running to idle and responds to the host completion event. Web Audio API generates the tones. It is for users who want an audible task-finished cue.
想让 DSH 网页在任务跑完时响几声提醒我
有没有办法在离开页面时听到任务完成提示音
Play an audible alert in the browser when my DSH task finishes.
dsh-task-completion-beep 的功能「任务结束提示音」：检测到 DSH 界面从运行状态变为空闲时，在浏览器合成并播放五声短音。任务状态来自页面按钮变化；音调通过 Web Audio API 生成。
dsh-task-completion-beep 的功能「完成事件响应」：宿主派发 deepseek-harness:task-completed 浏览器事件时也会播放五声短音；插件卸载时移除该事件监听器并断开界面观察器。

DSH Web 插件：检测到任务运行结束时，在浏览器中播放五声短提示音。

dsh-task-completion-beep README · 功能：- 通过 Web Audio API 生成五声 880 Hz 提示音，无需音频文件或外部运行时依赖。
- 监听 DSH 界面中任务运行状态从运行到空闲的变化。
- 同时响应 `deepseek-harness:task-completed` 浏览器事件（如果宿主发送该事件）。
- 使用 Web 插件生命周期管理观察器和事件监听器，卸载时清理。
- 仅在浏览器中运行，不访问网络、不读取或写入用户数据。

> 浏览器的自动播放策略可能影响声音。若浏览器尚未允许页面播放音频，请先与页面交互后再测试。

dsh-task-completion-beep README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:flyhigao/dsh-task-completion-beep
```

然后重启 `dsh web` 并刷新页面。开始一项新任务，等任务结束后应听到五声提示音。

dsh-task-completion-beep README · 本地开发安装：```bash
git clone https://github.com/flyhigao/dsh-task-completion-beep.git
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-task-completion-beep
```

安装后重启 `dsh web`。

dsh-task-completion-beep README · 开发：- DSH 服务端入口：`lib/index.js`
- 浏览器插件入口：`client/client.js`
- DSH bundle manifest：`cordis.patch.yml`

客户端 bundle 手工维护，无需构建步骤。检查语法：

```bash
node --check client/client.js
node --check lib/index.js
```

A DSH Web plugin that plays five short beeps in the browser when a task is detected to have finished running.

dsh-task-completion-beep README · Features：- Generates five 880 Hz tones with the Web Audio API; no audio assets or external runtime dependencies.
- Observes the DSH UI for a running-to-idle task transition.
- Also responds to the browser `deepseek-harness:task-completed` event if the host dispatches it.
- Cleans up its observer and event listener through the Web plugin lifecycle.
- Runs only in the browser; it does not access the network or read/write user data.
dsh-task-completion-beep README · Features：> Browser autoplay policies may affect playback. If audio is blocked before the page has been interacted with, interact with the page and try again.

dsh-task-completion-beep README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:flyhigao/dsh-task-completion-beep
```

Restart `dsh web` and refresh the page. Start a new task; five short beeps should play when it finishes.

dsh-task-completion-beep README · Local development install：```bash
git clone https://github.com/flyhigao/dsh-task-completion-beep.git
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-task-completion-beep
```

Restart `dsh web` after installation.

dsh-task-completion-beep README · Development：- DSH host entry: `lib/index.js`
- Browser plugin entry: `client/client.js`
- DSH bundle manifest: `cordis.patch.yml`

The client bundle is hand-maintained and does not require a build step. Check syntax with:

```bash
node --check client/client.js
node --check lib/index.js
```
